description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes between Mr. B. P. Gamarachchi, Malabe Vs. Lanka Industrial Estates Ltd. Makola, Mr. S. A. Kamalasena Buttala Vs. Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt.) Ltd. (S and E)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily consists of orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and exercises powers granted by that legislation. While it mentions a Minister's name, this is in the context of executing statutory powers rather than announcing a personnel change or detailing portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory/legal in nature, dealing with the implementation of labor dispute resolution mechanisms under existing law.
